svg.title: What goes in, and what reads from it
svg.desc: Six systems send information into one shared place, which holds a checked record for each hotel, client and trip. Four screens stand on it, the briefing, ask, itinerary and client profile, all reading the same hotel's record, lifted out of its slot.
